name: Sleep Health
title: Sleep Health Relief Guide
introduction: Sleep health is essential for overall physical and mental well-being. In Ayurveda, proper sleep (Nidra) is considered one of the three pillars of life. Good sleep restores energy, improves immunity and supports emotional balance. Poor sleep can lead to fatigue, stress and various health issues.
description:
Sleep health refers to the quality, duration and consistency of sleep that allows the body and mind to function properly. In Ayurveda, Nidra (sleep) is one of the three fundamental pillars of life, along with diet (Ahara) and lifestyle (Brahmacharya).
Proper sleep helps in repairing the body, improving brain function, strengthening immunity and maintaining hormonal balance. It also supports memory, concentration and emotional stability.
Modern lifestyle factors such as excessive screen time, stress, irregular sleep schedules, caffeine intake and lack of physical activity can disturb natural sleep patterns. Poor sleep can result in fatigue, irritability, lack of focus and weakened immunity.

Over time, chronic sleep disturbance can lead to serious health issues like anxiety, depression and metabolic disorders.
Ayurveda recommends natural ways to improve sleep such as maintaining a regular sleep schedule, calming the mind before bedtime, avoiding heavy meals at night and creating a peaceful sleep environment.
Balanced sleep brings relaxation, mental clarity and overall vitality, helping the body stay refreshed and energized.
remedies: Maintain a regular sleep schedule (sleep and wake at same time)
Create a calm and dark sleeping environment
Do light yoga or stretching in the evening
Avoid caffeine and heavy meals at night
Use relaxing oils for head massage (Abhyanga)
foods_to_eat: Warm milk with nutmeg or turmeric
Light dinners like khichdi or soups
Herbal teas like chamomile or tulsi
foods_to_avoid: Heavy and spicy food before sleep
